text: By now you might feel your body just fine, and still, the moment a real feeling comes up in a session, you slide away from it. Maybe you start explaining the feeling instead of feeling it, or you agree with whatever the therapist says so you don't have to stay in it. What helps then is a therapist who catches you sliding away and brings you back to the feeling, and a few talk therapies are built around doing exactly that.
reader: an adult working through the guide who can feel their body by now but slides away from feelings in therapy sessions, deciding whether to look for one of these therapists, and which one
